subject: Set up Alembic and write initial state.db migration
description:
Configure Alembic to manage `state.db` schema only (DBOS owns its own `dbos.db`). Write `migrations/001_init.py` creating all tables and indexes per §7.3 SQL definitions.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] `alembic.ini` and `migrations/env.py` configured to target `state.db`.
- [ ] Initial migration creates: `users`, `sessions`, `conversation_history`, `delegations`, `delegation_output`, `delegation_heartbeats`, `daily_costs`.
- [ ] All indexes from §7.3 created (e.g. `idx_sessions_user_thread_active`, `idx_history_session`, `idx_delegations_user_status`, etc.).
- [ ] Foreign key references defined per the ER diagram.
- [ ] Migration runs idempotently against an empty `state.db`.

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Migration handles repeated `alembic upgrade head` runs.
- [ ] `approvals` table is intentionally NOT in this migration (added in Phase 4).

**Testing Requirements:**
• Integration: `alembic upgrade head` against a fresh SQLite produces all tables with expected columns and indexes
• Integration: foreign-key constraints enforced (insert into delegation referencing missing user fails)

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 7.3, 9.1
activeForm: Setting up Alembic with initial migration
